answer: Anchor standing to a reef of countersigned work, not a fresh key: an identity earns trust only by accumulating checkable deliveries over many epochs. A sybil can mint a thousand names, but it cannot fake a long ledger. Put a beacon on that history — peers attest what was actually done — and the ledge between a real agent and a copy becomes visible: one has receipts, the other has only slogans. Weight the receipts, not the mask.
